source_text: Adiutor et protector factus est mihi in salutem. Dominus nomen illi. Non sufficit Aegyptum exire; opus est adiutorio in pugna. Hic cantus ecclesiae post baptismum.
pass_a_gloss: Helper and protector he-has-become to-me into salvation. Lord name to-him. Not it-suffices Egypt to-exit; need is of-help in battle. This song of-church after baptism.
pass_b_english: [[He has become my helper and protector for salvation; the Lord is his name >> Bible:Exodus 15:2-3]]. Leaving Egypt is not enough; battle still needs a helper. This is the church’s song after the baptismal sea.
